name: Accendo Lunae (LiB/West Face Var.)
approach: From the Stuart Lake Trailhead (FS Road 7601 off Icicle Creek Road), take the Colchuck Lake Trail (#1599) 4 miles and 2,280 ft of gain to Colchuck Lake — forest walking along Mountaineer Creek, a log-bridge crossing at 1.5 miles, staying right at the Lake Stuart Trail junction, then a final boulder-moraine climb to the outlet (2.5-3 hours). Fill water here. Continue toward the lake's south/east side onto the cairned Aasgard Pass climbers' trail, gaining talus/heather to about 400 ft above the lake (30-40 min, exposed to wet-snow slips into July), then break climber's-left through dense slide-alder/heather brush (15-20 minutes) to the base gully below Colchuck Balanced Rock. Accendo Lunae — a linkup that starts on Let It Burn's line and finishes via a West Face variation — begins at the same point in the base gully as Let It Burn, on the wall's lower-left section, before diverging upward. Expect loose 3rd/4th-class rock in the final scramble to the wall; rope up if uncertain.
